messages:
Maya Rao: Heads up — planning cross-cloud key rotation tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Goal: enable KMS auto-rotation for master keys, but do manual rewrap for envelope keys in prod. Need compatibility checklist, RBAC scope, audit hooks, and incident steps.
Aj Chen: +1. We should ensure older ciphertexts remain readable by any pinned model-serving instances during rollout. Canaries first.
Henry Morales: Agree. Main risks: partial rewrap failures and services still holding cached old DEKs. Need a clear freeze/rollback plan.
security-bot: Scheduled scan: key-rotation-prereqs OK for aws-kms-prod (3/4), gcp-kms-prod (4/4), azure-kv-prod (3/4). Missing: KeyVault diagnostic settings on one subscription.
Lia Patel: Audit logging checklist: enable CloudTrail+KMS events (AWS), Cloud Audit Logs for CryptoKey versions (GCP), KeyVault diagnostic settings -> EventHub/Storage (Azure). Make sure logs include principal, key_version, operation, and request_id. Sample log line: `INFO 2026-05-03T10:12:01Z key_rewrap user=svc-redwood-ingest key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/x/cryptoKeys/ckey/versions/2 request_id=abc123 status=SUCCESS`
Aj Chen: RBAC: create a rewrap role with only kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey and rewrap permission; grant that role only to infra-oncall and the rotation job service account. Example IAM snippet: ```json
{"role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter", "members": ["serviceAccount:rotation-job@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}
```
Henry Morales: Incident - if rewrap fails mid-rollout: 1) stop new writes (put objects into read-only), 2) suspend rotation job, 3) run audit query to list failed objects, 4) trigger manual rewrap for failed prefixes, 5) if >5% failure, failover to fallback key + open incident. Postmortem: include token-level cost delta and latency regression.
infra-oncall: Canary plan: rotate in staging then 2 small prod namespaces (search-prod, embeddings-prod) separated by 30m. Monitor: 5xx rate, decrypt error rate, KV cache miss rate. Alert thresholds: decrypt_errors > 0.5% for 5m -> pager.
Maya Rao: Also add a quick smoke rewrap CLI for engineers to test against a single object. Keep MFA required for manual rewrap ops.
Aj Chen: CLI snippets: ```bash
# AWS manual rewrap (example)
aws kms reencrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://object.blob --source-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/old --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/new --output text > object.rewrapped

# GCP manual rewrap (example)
gcloud kms keys versions encrypt --key=my-key --location=global --keyring=my-ring --plaintext-file=object.blob --ciphertext-file=object.rewrapped

# Azure manual rewrap (example)
az keyvault key encrypt --name myKey --vault-name myVault --alg RSA-OAEP --value @object.blob > object.rewrapped
```
Lia Patel: QA: run rewrap on 200 sample objects across different sizes (1KB, 64KB, 2MB), verify round-trip decrypt, and confirm audit entries exist for each operation. Add a schema regression test for ciphertext header versioning.
Maya Rao: Good. I'll schedule rotation at 10:00 UTC, canary window 10:00-11:30, broad rollout 11:30-13:00. infra-oncall you own the runbook execution, Aj and Lia support QA + RBAC changes. Please drop final checklist here when ready. :thumbsup:
